metaTitle: Garage Building Okotoks: Town Permits, Prices and Quotes
metaDescription: Garage building in Okotoks: Town permit rules, what one builder advertises for 1, 2 and 3-car garages, and how to line up quotes. Call (403) 555-0162.
heroSub: Okotoks is a Town south of Calgary with its own garage permit rules and its own builders. Here is what the Town publishes, what one builder advertises, and how to line up written quotes.
introHtml:
Garage building in Okotoks runs on the Town of Okotoks' rules, not the City of Calgary's, so a plan that works on a Calgary lot still needs checking with the Town before anyone pours a slab. This page covers what the Town publishes about detached garages and what one builder advertises for the town.

This site is advertising. It builds nothing, pulls no permits and holds no contractor licence. It puts Okotoks homeowners in touch with independent garage builders, who quote and contract directly with you. Call now on (403) 555-0162 and ask for two or three comparable written quotes.

services.title: Detached garages
services.desc: Single, double and triple garages on an Okotoks lot. One Okotoks builder advertises 14 by 20, 20 by 20, 20 by 22 and triple packages. See the detached garage page for the full picture.

services.title: Garage packages
services.desc: Fixed-size packages make quotes easier to compare, as long as you check what each one includes. Insulation, drywall, gas and the sub-panel are often priced as add-ons. More on the garage packages page.

services.title: Custom and oversized garages
services.desc: The Town does not let a garage exceed the height of the principal building, and its 2025 form asks for an engineer or architect above 55 m². Taller doors and workshop layouts need that checked early. See custom garages.

services.title: Garage replacement
services.desc: If an old garage is coming down, ask each builder whether removal is in the quote or priced separately. Confirm any demolition requirements with the Town of Okotoks. See garage replacement.

sections.heading: What the Town of Okotoks says about garage permits
sections.html:
The Town's building and renovation permits page says a building permit is required for residential detached garages, and that these structures are not permitted to exceed the height of the principal building. A development permit is also required in some cases: when the property is not in the Traditional Neighbourhood (TN) District, when the structure does not meet the Building and Placement Standards in the Land Use Bylaw, or when it is taller than the primary building.

For a lot in the TN District, the Town's 2025 Detached Garage Guidelines form lists a 0.6 m (2 ft) setback from the interior side property line, 1.0 m from the rear property line, and 3.0 m from the secondary frontage on a corner lot. Windows and doors are not permitted within 1.2 m (4 ft) of a property line, and eaves must sit at least 0.45 m (18 in) back. The same form asks for a professional engineer or architect if the garage structure exceeds 55 m².

The Town says to allow 5 to 10 business days for a permit to be reviewed and approved after payment. It points to a Permit Fee Calculator rather than publishing a garage fee, so ask the builder who quotes your job to say who applies for the permit and what the fee is. Always confirm the rules for your own lot with the Town of Okotoks before you sign anything.

sections.heading: What one Okotoks builder advertises
sections.html:
Polskiy Building, on its Okotoks garage page, advertises 1-car garages (14 by 20) starting from $18,660 plus GST. Its 2-car garages start from $20,376 plus GST for 20 by 20 and $23,853 plus GST for 20 by 22, and its 3-car garages start from $44,800 plus GST. These are that builder's advertised starting prices, not a market average and not a quote from this site.

The same page lists add-ons, all plus GST: insulation and poly (vapour barrier) at $1,700, drywall and insulation at $3,000, a gas line with permits (where available) at $3,000, and a 50,000 BTU gas heater at $2,000. A 240V sub-panel upgrade is listed at $900 for 40A, $1,000 for 50A and $1,200 for 60A. A garage you can heat and use as a workshop in January costs noticeably more than the starting price.

Starting prices are the low end. One Calgary firm, Precision Construction and Decora, publishes cost ranges of $55,000 to $90,000 for a finished double garage, and says they are typical market ranges, not fixed prices. Builders also differ on what the base price includes, which is why a written quote with the inclusions spelled out beats a headline number. The Calgary garage cost page sets out more builders' figures, each attributed to the firm that publishes it.

sections.heading: Getting two or three quotes before the spring rush
sections.html:
Garage projects tend to be planned in winter and built in spring or summer, so ask for quotes early. One Calgary builder, Hammerhead Construction, says more projects are completed in the summer months, so demand for product and labour can be higher. It also says garages can be built in cooler months, but concrete then needs winter heat, which can add to the cost.

Build times are quoted by builders, not by the Town. Sahi Contracting says most Calgary builds take 3 to 5 weeks once permits are in hand, and Falcon Contracting says 4 to 8 weeks from excavation to inspection, with permits and weather able to stretch that. Ask each builder for a start date and a finish date in writing.

If a builder asks for money before the work is done, Service Alberta says a prepaid contracting business needs a provincial licence, and its Find a Licensed Business search lets you check. A licence is not an endorsement of quality. For other towns, see Cochrane, Airdrie, Chestermere and Rocky View County.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to build a detached garage in Okotoks?
faq.a: The Town of Okotoks says a building permit is required for residential detached garages. A development permit is also required when the property is not in the Traditional Neighbourhood District, when the garage does not meet the Land Use Bylaw standards, or when it is taller than the primary building. Confirm your lot's requirements with the Town before you commit to a builder.

faq.q: How close to the property line can an Okotoks garage go?
faq.a: For the Traditional Neighbourhood District, the Town's 2025 garage form lists 0.6 m from the interior side property line, 1.0 m from the rear property line and 3.0 m from the secondary frontage on a corner lot. Windows and doors are not permitted within 1.2 m of a property line, and eaves must be at least 0.45 m back. Lots in other districts follow other standards, so check your district with the Town.

faq.q: How much does a garage cost in Okotoks?
faq.a: Polskiy Building advertises starting prices of $18,660 plus GST for a 14 by 20, $20,376 plus GST for a 20 by 20 and $44,800 plus GST for a triple. Insulation, drywall, gas and electrical upgrades are listed as add-ons. These are one builder's advertised figures, not a quote, so get written quotes that list what is included.

faq.q: How long does it take to get a garage permit and build in Okotoks?
faq.a: The Town says to allow 5 to 10 business days for a permit to be reviewed and approved after payment. Build times come from builders: Sahi Contracting says 3 to 5 weeks once permits are in hand, and Falcon Contracting says 4 to 8 weeks from excavation to inspection. Ask each builder for dates in writing.
